title: The New Best Way to Make Money Reselling Online?!
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The guest endorses Resellbot, says he knows its developer, and directs viewers to his own auction link. No compensation is disclosed.

idea.name: Live selling liquidation apparel
idea.one_liner: Buy low-cost liquidation apparel, then resell it live to consumers or supply live sellers, earning a margin on each item.
